set.body:
Consumer: PLS Neuro live response-model explorer (plsneuro bd-01M2360D6MQ6GVA1P0RJR7NANF epic; C2 bd child). Verified by plsneuro ReprojectionSpikeProbe (docs/verification/response-explorer-c1.md): LWU family reaches p95 span residual 1e-2 at J=9, 1e-3 at J=13; map error ~10x smaller than HRF span residual.

Scope (design module, shared): a ReachableResponseBasis built from a parametric HRF family sampled on a shared lag grid. Orthonormal basis via the smaller Gram eigendecomposition (Gale Eigen.eigSymmetric), descending singular values, cumulative energy fractions, rank truncation. Projection of any single-basis Hrf onto the library: coefficients (the W(theta) column) plus relative span residual by truncation rank, so callers can pick J with a receipt and refuse out-of-span requests.

Placement decision: hrf module is deliberately Gale-free (cats+spire only); design already depends on hrf + Gale and owns response-basis policy (ResponseBasisReview). Constructor and projection therefore land in scalafim.fmri.design.

Acceptance: shared munit suite passing on JVM and JS: orthonormality, descending spectrum, exact recovery of family members at full rank, monotone held-out residual decay, basis-member projection = unit coefficient, typed error paths.
set.title: Reachable response-basis library: family SVD, span-residual receipts, W(theta) projection
